truth.key_detail: commit 6b2ec81 makes the worker's job claim query order by jobs.priority and ships migration 0002 adding that column, but the worker was deployed without running the migration; the column does not exist, so every claim fails with UndefinedColumn and the worker crashes and restarts in a loop (exit code 1, not OOM)
red_herrings: docker-compose.yml commit raising the payments stub memory limit 64m -> 128m, deployed about six minutes before the incident; makes memory/OOM look plausible, but the worker shows oom_killed false and exit code 1
worker restart loop and growing backlog of order_confirmation jobs, which look like the OOM pattern but are a consequence of the failing claim query
commit routing uncaught exceptions through the JSON logger, deployed to the worker about ten minutes before the incident; the worker ran normally on it
the jobs payload deprecation WARNING repeated on every worker restart; it also appears at startup in the healthy period
possible payment retry WARNINGs/errors while the payments stub is recreated during its own deploy, well before the incident
truth.expected_fix: run the pending migration (alembic upgrade head, i.e. deploy.sh --migrate) so jobs.priority exists, then restart the worker; the backlog of order_confirmation jobs will then drain (or roll the worker back to the previous commit)
truth.notes: The culprit commit changes app/models.py, app/routers/checkout.py, worker/main.py and adds migrations/versions/0002_job_priority.py, but only the worker is deployed and without --migrate. The api keeps running its previous image, so checkout still works and keeps enqueueing order_confirmation jobs that are never claimed. The worker crashes right after startup on the claim query; each restart logs 'service started' (new version), the deprecation WARNING and a CRITICAL 'uncaught exception' with the SQLAlchemy ProgrammingError / psycopg.errors.UndefinedColumn text. Docker's restart back-off makes restarts sparser over time. db.log has the matching postgres 'column "priority" does not exist' errors. db/schema.sql has no priority column on jobs and alembic_version stays at 0001.
